healthy_cattle_baseline.description: Fully healthy Sahiwal-type cattle, all readings well inside No-Risk bands.
healthy_cattle_baseline.what_this_tests: Sanity baseline — model should predict 'none' with high confidence.

healthy_buffalo_baseline.description: Fully healthy Murrah-type buffalo, all readings well inside No-Risk bands.
healthy_buffalo_baseline.what_this_tests: Sanity baseline for the other species — model should predict 'none' with high confidence.

clinical_mastitis_cattle_severe.description: Cattle deep in High-Risk on every single parameter (EC 6.2, pH 7.15, SCC 7.8, etc.), no heat confound.
clinical_mastitis_cattle_severe.what_this_tests: Textbook severe/clinical case — model should predict 'clinical' with high confidence.

clinical_mastitis_buffalo_severe.description: Buffalo deep in High-Risk on every parameter using buffalo-specific (lower) cutoffs, no heat confound.
clinical_mastitis_buffalo_severe.what_this_tests: Textbook severe/clinical case for the species with the least literature support — model should predict 'clinical' with high confidence.

heat_stress_false_positive_cattle.description: THI Emergency (88) driving up EC/udder/milk/body temperature, but pH, yield, rumination and standing/lying all stay clean — a heat wave, not mastitis.
heat_stress_false_positive_cattle.what_this_tests: The exact false-positive scenario Section 4 of the spec warns about. A good model/heuristic should NOT confidently call this 'clinical' despite several High-Risk individual readings.

exact_boundary_case_cattle.description: Every cattle parameter set to EXACTLY its own No/Low/Moderate/High cutoff boundary value.
exact_boundary_case_cattle.what_this_tests: Edge-of-band behavior — where bands actually flip, and whether the model's decision is stable right at a published cutoff.

sensor_malfunction_extreme.description: Values far beyond anything physiologically plausible in a healthy or diseased animal (EC 12, pH 9, body temp 44C, THI 110, gases in the thousands) — simulating a faulty/miscalibrated sensor.
sensor_malfunction_extreme.what_this_tests: Out-of-distribution robustness. The model was never trained near these values, so this checks how it extrapolates rather than what the 'correct' answer is — worth eyeballing the raw probabilities, not just the top class.

species_conditioning_demo_as_cattle.description: EC=4.6 and pH=6.80 entered with species=Cattle. Pair this with 'species_conditioning_demo_as_buffalo' (identical numbers, species=Buffalo).
species_conditioning_demo_as_cattle.what_this_tests: Whether the SAME raw sensor numbers are correctly read as different risk depending on species — 4.6 mS/cm is Low-Risk for cattle but Moderate-Risk for buffalo per the spec's own species-specific cutoffs.

species_conditioning_demo_as_buffalo.description: The exact same readings as 'species_conditioning_demo_as_cattle' (EC=4.6, pH=6.80, etc.) but with species=Buffalo.
species_conditioning_demo_as_buffalo.what_this_tests: Direct side-by-side of species conditioning — compare per_parameter_risk_band against the Cattle version of this case.

borderline_subclinical_multi_weak_signal.description: No single parameter is in High-Risk, but every parameter independently sits in Moderate-Risk at once.
borderline_subclinical_multi_weak_signal.what_this_tests: Whether the model aggregates many simultaneous weak/moderate signals into a real subclinical call, rather than needing one dramatic outlier. Also a good case for comparing against the Section-7 composite heuristic, which lands almost exactly on its own No/Moderate/High boundary here.

vaccinated_history_but_currently_healthy.description: Buffalo with 3 prior mastitis episodes and current vaccination, but every current reading is clean/No-Risk.
vaccinated_history_but_currently_healthy.what_this_tests: Fairness/robustness check — the model should trust today's clean readings and predict 'none', not over-weight prior_mastitis_history into a false alarm.
